_README: REPLACE BEFORE LAUNCH — every entry below is illustrative sample copy written to demonstrate the layout. None of these are real client quotes and none should be published as if they were. Replace each with a genuine, attributable testimonial (with the client's permission) before the site goes live, or delete the section entirely until you have real ones. The `placeholder` flag drives a visible notice in the UI while it is true — set it to false only when the quote is genuine.
